# Dates, EmptyString-vs-ProperString via String, …). A cross-family pair
# raises [aql/incomparable] and directs the caller to tcmp. The full
# total order itself is exercised in compare.tsv via tcmp.
# Equality (eq / neq / deq) is NOT restricted: cross-type compares as
